# Pull request checklist

## Ownership and scope

- Owner and registration number:
- Assessed use case:
- Feature branch:

## Frozen rules implemented

- [ ] The implemented rules are listed and linked to the frozen design.
- [ ] No other member's workflow or ownership was absorbed.
- [ ] Any shared-contract change has affected-owner approval.

## Verification

- [ ] Meaningful positive, negative, boundary and failure tests were added.
- [ ] Coverage result is recorded and meets the agreed threshold.
- [ ] Lint, formatting, type-check, tests, Prisma checks and builds pass.

Coverage summary:

- UML or documentation impact:
- Schema migration impact:

- Known limitations:

## UI evidence

- [ ] Screenshots are attached for UI changes, or this pull request has no UI change.
- [ ] Screenshots and flow descriptions match the revised design.
